snippet.title: Pokémon TCG Pocket: Mega Rising Expansion! | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Mega Rising Expansion brings Mega Pokémon ex to Pokémon TCG Pocket!

Expand your collection with these powerful Pokémon ex and enjoy updates that make collecting easier than ever!
